newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear see Q2 EPS near last year's $1.22.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear see Q2 EPS near last year's $1.22.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co said Monday it expects to post second quarter earnings per share close to the $1.22 reported for the quarter last year, despite an 18-day strike at 10 of its plants.
Unrecovered production costs caused by the strike totaled about $50 million, the company said.

"We expect to have all 10 plants back to full production by Wednesday, and we intend to recover lost production through additional work schedules over the next few weeks and months," Goodyear chairman Sam Gibara said.
"For the balance of the second quarter, we have challenged all of our global operations to aggressively seek to offset as much of the strike costs as possible," he said.
Last week, Goodyear workers ratified a six-year labor agreement, ending a strike by nearly 13,000 United Steelworkers of America members which began April 20.
